purpose: Generic guards for common CP2K workflow failure modes

regressions.observed: A template was used without retrieving the declared versioned manual.
regressions.guard: Return MANUAL_REQUIRED and block formal submission until the exact manual is recorded.

regressions.observed: A 2026-style nested DOS/PDOS block was copied into a 2024.x input.
regressions.guard: Select the template family from the declared executable version and run the version-aware linter.

regressions.observed: A CP2K input was submitted with a remaining template token.
regressions.guard: Treat every unresolved {{SLOT}} as a hard error.

regressions.observed: A wavefunction restart from another CP2K version or build family was reused without evidence.
regressions.guard: Require exact executable/version/build compatibility or start a fresh reference calculation.

regressions.observed: An output file existed after an interrupted or failed run.
regressions.guard: Require return code, CP2K normal termination, SCF evidence, finite energy, and property-specific gates.

regressions.observed: The run ended normally but did not emit the requested projected-density artifact.
regressions.guard: Keep the capability unvalidated and report the missing artifact; never synthesize it.

regressions.observed: Density cubes with different origins, axes, or dimensions were subtracted.
regressions.guard: Run the common-grid audit and block subtraction on any mismatch.

regressions.observed: A bulk periodic cell was reported as a surface work function without a slab and vacuum plateau.
regressions.guard: Require slab geometry, vacuum, dipole policy, potential convention, and plateau evidence.

regressions.observed: A population, periodic RESP, or REPEAT-like charge set was relabeled as another method.
regressions.guard: Keep methods separate and report mapping, charge closure, fit quality, and sampling sensitivity.
